title: Diagnostic Engine Hours After a Malfunction Report on Ridgeline Tool Rental
content:
When a malfunction is reported on metered Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment, diagnostic running is allowed for in the engine hours included.

> A malfunction report adds diagnostic hours to the engine hours included: when the agreement carries a malfunction report and the return inspection recorded the malfunction as confirmed, 4 hours are added; when the agreement carries a malfunction report and the return inspection did not confirm it, 2 hours are added; when the agreement carries no malfunction report, no hour is added.

The added hours count as engine hours included and are taken off the engine hours used with the rest of the included hours.

## Records that decide the hours

- Malfunction reports registered on the agreement.
- The return inspection line on the agreement and whether it recorded a confirmed malfunction.

## Decision table

| Malfunction report on the agreement | Return inspection recorded a confirmed malfunction | Hours added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 4 |
| yes | no | 2 |
| no | not relevant | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A telehandler's hydraulic fault is reported on day 3 and the inspection records the malfunction as confirmed: 4 hours are added.
- A skid steer is reported as stalling, but the inspection records it clean with no damage: 2 hours are added.
